summary:
Scope: the fresh producer enrollment of an fdev workspace against a live Home telemetry receiver, executed under #4638 (Root admitted each effect separately; the sanctioned commands and the custody rules are in the cited preparation recipe, which stays canonical). This record keeps only what the journey did and did not establish, so a later reader does not over-claim.

Accepted by Root on the recorded journeys: a single explicit enrollment with a distinct principal and new key and no reuse of the legacy queue; a lost acknowledgement retried to the existing receipt (count rose by exactly one); revocation answered with a terminal unauthorized-scope while the producer queue stayed intact (on a throwaway Host); a correction mechanism where revision 2 is recorded and revision 1 stays immutable; browser login, workspace scoping and logout; four consecutive unattended drain ticks with exit 0; and a before/after comparison of every producer and receiver bound, none near its limit.

Limits kept: the correction source was labelled synthetic, so it is not a natural correction; the browser pass is not a rerun of the earlier twelve assertions; unattended drain covered a manually captured real Codex rollout, and growth is keyed to batch ids, not dispatch ids, because no codex-exec dispatch ran. Unknown, not tested: receiver-side expiry of applied receipts (no time-based expiry was found in the admission or capacity paths read), disk-full or SQLITE_FULL behaviour, off-machine retention and recovery. Whole-UTEL acceptance, complete attribution and the held historical effects remain with Root and the parent outcome.

Lessons that held: preparation recipes should list their corrections after execution (podman exec drops stdin without -i, so a piped config install wrote an empty file and was restored from an in-container copy made first; the configuration directory must be exactly 0700; the engine TLS path is exercised only by the first real send, not by activation); an init retry on a provisioned store is safe. Live counts, hashes and heads are deliberately not recorded here; refresh them from the receiver before relying on any of this.
title: Fresh fdev telemetry enrollment is accepted for a bounded set of journeys; expiry, disk-full, off-machine and natural-correction cases stay Unknown
